thread:
carla_customer: Hey - our integration to /invoke payment_tool started failing this morning. We get a 400 with a JSON schema validation error mentioning additionalProperties and missing required field. Example response pasted below.

maya_support: Sorry for the trouble — can you paste the exact request body you sent and the full error body from the API? Also which SDK/version or raw curl?

carla_customer: Sending raw curl (we're on our own infra). Payload we POSTed: 
```json
{
  "amount": 2500,
  "currency": "USD",
  "customer_id": 12345,
  "meta": { "source": "billing-service" },
  "debug_flag": true
}
```
And the API error: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "json_schema_validation_error",
    "message": "Request failed validation",
    "details": [
      {"path": "/customer_id", "message": "12345 is not of type 'string'"},
      {"path": "/", "message": "Additional properties are not allowed ('debug_flag' was unexpected)"}
    ]
  }
}
```

maya_support: Got it. Two clear issues: customer_id expected as string (we accept UUIDs) and top-level additionalProperties are disallowed by the tool's function schema. We'll try to repro. Adding @ben_eng for schema guidance.

ben_eng: Thanks @maya_support. Likely the function schema for payment_tool declares required ["customer_id"] (type: string) and additionalProperties: false on the top-level. The SDK used to coerce ints -> strings for legacy clients but if you're calling raw curl there's no coercion. Can you confirm the schema id/version you hit (the response sometimes includes schema_version header)?

carla_customer: Header says X-Tool-Schema: payment_tool-v1.2.0. We only noticed it after a deploy this morning. Nothing changed on our side except we switched a queue consumer that does JSONify differently.

maya_support: Repro steps we ran locally with the same payload returned the identical validator error. Quick workaround: set "customer_id" to a string and remove "debug_flag", e.g. 
```json
{
  "amount": 2500,
  "currency": "USD",
  "customer_id": "12345",
  "meta": { "source": "billing-service" }
}
```
This should pass validation.

carla_customer: That works, thanks. However this is a regression for us because we previously relied on numeric ids being coerced. Is there a change log for v1.2.0?

ben_eng: We pushed a tightening of the schema in v1.2.0 to reject unknown top-level keys (we wanted to prevent stray debug flags reaching the tool). The coercion layer was also moved into the official SDK to avoid silent type conversions. We didn't intend to break raw callers but the change landed.

jorge_sre: Noted — we see a spike of these validation 400s around 2026-03-16T07:20Z matching the version rollout. If customers are using raw HTTP we should document the break and consider a gateway shim.

maya_support: Action items: 1) Provide customer remediation (already done). 2) Offer a backward-compatibility hotfix path: either server-side shim to coerce ints->strings and strip unknown top-level keys OR a documented migration note for raw callers. 3) Create internal incident/ticket.

ben_eng: I can put together a minimal gateway shim in the routing layer that does: 
```js
// naive shim: coerce numeric id to string and remove known-unsafe topkeys
if (typeof body.customer_id === 'number') body.customer_id = String(body.customer_id);
[ 'debug_flag', 'trace_id' ].forEach(k => delete body[k]);
```
We'll gate behind a feature flag and roll to hosted and Dedicated. But we need product approval for defaulting to lenient behavior.

carla_customer: A feature flag rollout would be perfect. Any ETA? We're blocked on payments for a subset of users.

maya_support: I created ticket INF-2026-317 and flagged it P1. Ben, can you add an initial PR target for EOD today? Jorge, can SRE stand by for a quick canary?

ben_eng: Will open PR this afternoon. I'll include unit tests showing rejection before shim and acceptance after shim, and a changelog note.

jorge_sre: We can canary to 5% traffic in us-east-1 and monitor validation 400 rate; if it drops we can expand. Also add a log counter for numbers coerced so we can track how many customers depend on numeric ids.

carla_customer: Appreciate it. Please cc me on the PR/ticket.

maya_support: CC'd on INF-2026-317. For now, please patch your integration to stringify customer_id to avoid the immediate 400s. We'll follow up when the shim is available. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment queued for routing-shim-featureflag (pr/4823) — scheduled canary in us-east-1 at 2026-03-16T18:00Z.
